claim: The Textile Service Group's own marketing states it serves both single city-centre flats and portfolios of serviced apartments in Greater Manchester; Airlinen advertises no minimum monthly commitment or long-term contract specifically for its Manchester operation.
detail: Found via additional desk research after the council-verdict reject on 2026-09-11. This is a more specific claim than the general 'weekly rounds by postcode' marketing already in competitive-map.md: it explicitly names single-flat intake as a served segment, not just a plausible inference from a postcode-round description. It still does not meet F1's acceptance criterion (a real quote or refusal obtained by contacting the provider as a prospective one-property host) -- it is the provider's own marketing copy, which is exactly the category council-devils-advocate's dissent warned against treating as settled. Grade stays estimated; F1 remains open.
